title: V03 Clip 6
shots: One year after the peak, Cisco was down about eighty percent.
2001 floor, red screens, people packing boxes, -80%
By October two thousand and two, your ten thousand dollars was worth around one thousand one hundred.
kitchen table 2002: envelope opens, brokerage statement slides out, total circled
So, be honest. At one thousand one hundred dollars, would you have sold, or held on?
hallway with two lit doors SELL and HOLD, people choosing, 2000-you in the middle
Tell me in the comments. Because holding meant this.
phone with comment cards sliding in
Cisco didn't go bankrupt. By twenty ten, its sales had more than doubled.
a busy campus HQ at day, glass revenue card 18.9B -> 40.0B
The business won. And you still waited almost twenty-six years to get back to ten thousand dollars.
park: life passes by (joggers, a bike, couples), 2000-you on the bench greying, years tick, $10,000
